process: x-cut TFLN, pump TM 0.764 um, signal TE 1.528 um, idler TM 1.528 um
St_method: central difference, two evaluations, step 5 nm: (Dk(t=0.605)-Dk(t=0.595))/0.010 um. Dk in rad/um. Numerically equal to rad/mm/nm. h fixed at 0.3 um (etch depth not changed with film).
Sw_method: central difference +/-40 nm at t=0.600, h=0.3
Sh_method: central difference +/-10 nm at t=0.600, w=1.4
group_index_method: quadratic fit of beta(omega) at lambda0 and lambda0+/-0.008 um; beta1=d(beta)/d(omega) in fs/um = ps/mm
